We’re both pretty outdoorsy and dabble a bit in the prepper life so it wasn’t an odd question to ask, and I responded with yes. He then slid a knife to me and asked me to check it out. Some additional context before getting into this next part. I’m the one who set him up with his fiancé, who happens to be very close friends to my ex, and you can kinda see where this is going.
